comment: Pages a phone-notification tap may open. public/research-sw.js keeps the same list (a test checks they match); every push payload url sent from scripts/research must be one of these, optionally with a #fragment. RESOLUTE (Nov 17): its alert notice opens /resolute/alerts/latest and its morning notice /resolute/morning. queries: the only query each page may carry (Nov 17: the owner's filming notice opens the price-target page with ?demo=nvda).
